_comment: Warm-up and cool-down building blocks. The engine assembles each session's warm-up from the 'general' pool plus the 'specific_by_category' entries that match the day's movements (8-10 min total), and a cool-down from the 'cooldown' pool (~5 min). active_recovery is the template used when a check-in forces an easy day.

general: 3 min easy bike or jump rope, building pace
Hip + ankle mobility: 60s each (hip openers, ankle rocks)
10 scap pulls or band pull-aparts, 10 arm circles each way

barbell: 2 rounds: 5 empty-bar reps of today's lift at a controlled tempo
10 air squats, 5 good-mornings with the empty bar
gymnastics: 10 slow push-ups or ring rows, 10 air squats
kettlebell: 2 rounds: 10 light KB deadlifts, 10 light KB swings to chest height
ball: 2 rounds: 8 light wall balls to a lower target, 8 air squats

cooldown: 2 min very easy bike or walk to bring heart rate down
Thoracic opener 60s; slow nasal breathing 1 min
Log how you feel and hydrate before you leave the gym

active_recovery.title: Active recovery
active_recovery.stimulus: Easy aerobic flush + mobility. Nothing hard — this protects tomorrow.
blocks: 15-20 min easy bike at a conversational pace (RPE <= 4)
5-8 min full-body mobility: hips, t-spine, shoulders, ankles
Optional: 2 x 30s easy plank, slow breathing
